description.p: Kalorite is a lightweight audio player. It supports all modern codecs and have simple and elegant design.
Thanks everyone for using Kalorite! This update includes:

ul.li: Complete UI rewrite in QML: fresh, modern and smooth look.
Synchronized lyrics: .lrc files support and dedicated lyrics viewer.
MusicBrainz integration: automatic album artwork and track metadata fetching.
Playback saving: Kalorite now remembers where you left off.
Fixed memory leaks, segfaults and shuffle behavior.
